regions.region: left-column Table 2, generic arrow, rows 1-14, and footnotes a-b
regions.finding: Fourteen independent substrate-scope entries were extracted with the shared two-stage conditions, NMR yield, isolated yield in parentheses, and E/Z >= 99/1. Scheme 2 evidence is merged into entry 1.

One present-paper experiment was extracted: nonterminal alkynone gives only cycloisomerization product 3c in 87% NMR yield. The scheme labels the alkynone 2e while the prose calls it 2d; both source statements are preserved as an unresolved discrepancy.
The M1-M4 pathway is explicitly a proposed rationale and is classified as mechanism, not as an executed experiment.

Table 2 omits atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Scheme 3 disagrees between label 2e in the drawing and 2d in prose.
All candidate structures and stereochemistry remain unverified.
